definitions: Situations, features, or actions that are inherently dangerous or prone to causing self-inflicted problems or damage, especially in programming or system design.
Design flaws or functionalities that make it easy for users to make mistakes that harm themselves or the system.
examples: The new API has several footguns that developers need to be aware of.
Using raw pointers in C++ can be a footgun if not handled carefully.
The system's default settings are a footgun for inexperienced users.
